[LTIM.6.1] The component slots `.hour`, `.minute`, `.second`,
`.day_of_week`, `.day`, `.month`, `.year` are valid on:

- The result of `t.utc` or `t.local(tz)` for `Time` values.
- A `Date` value directly (only `.day`, `.month`, `.year`,
  `.day_of_week`).

A component is a member of its receiver ([LGRA.9.6.2]); one its receiver does not
have is `DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER`.
